hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash # Set the genomic count (consent.sample_count) of every consent of the listed studies to -1 (dashboard shows "N/A"). # Parameters (Jenkins job parameters / env): # STUDIES phs accessions, separated by spaces, commas or newlines (phs000007 or phs000007.v33.p14) # DRY_RUN true = only show current values; change nothing # API_BASE dictionary ETL API (default http://dictionaryetl:8086/api, as in the Fetch Genomic Counts job) set -euo pipefail
readonly COUNT=-1 STUDIES="${STUDIES:-}" DRY_RUN="${DRY_RUN:-false}" API_BASE="${API_BASE:-http://dictionaryetl:8086/api}"
command -v jq >/dev/null && command -v curl >/dev/null || { echo "ERROR: needs curl and jq"; exit 2; } [[ -n "${STUDIES//[[:space:],]/}" ]] || { echo "ERROR: STUDIES is empty"; exit 2; }
REPORT="${WORKSPACE:-$PWD}/genomic_counts_set.csv" echo "study,consent_code,old_sample_count,new_sample_count,result" > "$REPORT" ok=0; failed=0
for raw in $(tr ',\n' ' ' <<< "$STUDIES"); do phs="${raw%%.*}" # phs000007.v33.p14 -> phs000007 if [[ ! "$phs" =~ ^phs[0-9]{6}$ ]]; then echo "SKIP '$raw': not a phs accession"; echo "$raw,,,,bad_accession" >> "$REPORT"; failed=$((failed + 1)); continue fi
code=$(curl -sS -o consents.json -w '%{http_code}' "${API_BASE}/consent?datasetRef=${phs}" || echo 000) if [[ "$code" == "204" ]]; then echo "SKIP $phs: no consents in the dictionary"; echo "$phs,,,,no_consents" >> "$REPORT"; failed=$((failed + 1)); continue elif [[ "$code" != "200" ]]; then echo "FAIL $phs: GET consents returned HTTP $code (study not in the dictionary?)" echo "$phs,,,,lookup_http_$code" >> "$REPORT"; failed=$((failed + 1)); continue fi
while IFS=$'\t' read -r consent old; do if [[ "$DRY_RUN" == "true" ]]; then echo "DRY $phs ${consent:-<no code>}: sample_count=$old (would set $COUNT)" echo "$phs,$consent,$old,$COUNT,dry_run" >> "$REPORT"; continue fi code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 --request PUT \ --data-urlencode "datasetRef=${phs}" --data-urlencode "consentCode=${consent}" \ --data-urlencode "sampleCount=${COUNT}" "${API_BASE}/consent/counts" || echo 000) if [[ "$code" == "200" ]]; then echo "OK $phs ${consent:-<no code>}: $old -> $COUNT"; echo "$phs,$consent,$old,$COUNT,updated" >> "$REPORT"; ok=$((ok + 1)) else echo "FAIL $phs ${consent:-<no code>}: PUT returned HTTP $code"; echo "$phs,$consent,$old,$COUNT,put_http_$code" >> "$REPORT"; failed=$((failed + 1)) fi done < <(jq -r '.[] | [(.consentCode // ""), (.sampleCount // "null" | tostring)] | @tsv' consents.json) done rm -f consents.json
echo; echo "updated=$ok failed=$failed report: $REPORT"; column -s, -t "$REPORT" 2>/dev/null || cat "$REPORT" (( failed == 0 )) || exit 1
